notes.title: Pro Drift Reloaded™ - 2020 UPDATE
notes.content:
The major update provided to Pro Drift Reloaded™ includes a large number of changes;

- New vehicles added
- New tracks with updated graphics.
- Updated drift physics and driving mechanics.
- Improved lighting, graphic quality.
- New vehicle garage.
- Drift events and time-trials.

Further updates will include an Online Multiplayer mode for players.

tags.feature: - Updated drift physics and driving mechanics.

notes.title: A new update for 2019!
notes.content:
We have been working hard to developing new content and updates for Pro Drift Reloaded!. We will continue to develop this game further and take the community feedback we have received to improve the game drastically. 

This game will not be abandoned by the developers and we have many updates  being developed for the future. 

Some of the new features we are adding to this game are; updated graphics, a complete new customization system, new UI and menus.

The Drifting will have;
New Physics and tunnings options to suit different styles.
2 Open World cities for drifting!
New Vehicles and customization options. 


We will be releasing a free off-road DLC with new vehicles!
the offroad DLC will include an Open World island that can be explored and enjoyed with the new Offroad Physics developed.

We will release more information soon!
